doc: Skill unlocks by quest or find (ADR 0018 item 6, docs/skill-unlocks.md). A skill not listed is free; its level requirement from Skills.txt still applies. Skill names are the Skills.txt keys (as the build tables use them; the display name is in the note when it differs). Events: quest:<id>, waypoint:<area>, boss:<superunique>, item:<kind>, clvl:<n>, alternatives joined by '|'. Source: the veteran schedule in docs/research/class-early-game.md section 2 (a veteran estimate, not measured): every tag S is that estimate, U is unsure or changed by this file (note says why). Moved or freed against the veteran schedule so that no row of the class's normal30 build tables is refused at the expected event levels (TestClassUnlocks).

unlocks.note: Both normal30 tables first spend it at clvl 15 or 17.
Veteran: Andariel. Moved earlier: Bone Spear is the main attack of the leveling table from clvl 18, and nothing the bot needs may lock after Bishibosh. Quest id U.
